{{Top|leg}}
A '''wind carrack''' was a type of [[wind rider]] employed by the [[Sevari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]]. They were generally armed with [[Catapult/Legends|catapults]] capable of launching glasslike spheres that exploded upon impact. The clans of the [[Southern Deserts]] favored wind carracks, as did the [[Spice lord|Spice Lord]] [[Xerxes Quintas]].
